desc_id: Setiap Waisak, umat Buddha berjalan kaki dari Candi Mendut ke Candi Pawon, lalu berakhir di Candi Borobudur. Mereka membawa api dan air suci dari Umbul Jumprit, Temanggung. Kita menghormatinya dengan menjaga ketenangan dan memberi jalan.
desc_en: Every Vesak, Buddhists walk from Mendut Temple to Pawon Temple and end at Borobudur Temple. They carry fire and holy water from Umbul Jumprit in Temanggung. We show respect by keeping quiet and making way.
